dataset: sklearn.load_digits; stratified 60/20/20 with split seed s, then validation/test split seed s+1; preprocessing scaler fit on train only
primary_metric: per-seed mean accuracy over 9 deterministic test corruption conditions: clean; noise sigma .2/.4/.6 times intensity 16; dropout .05/.15/.30; joint (.4,.15),(.6,.30); report equal-weight condition average then average over three seeds
conditions_seed: s+20000+int(noise*1000)+int(dropout*10000); clipping to [0,16]; exact same condition arrays for all arms
control: StandardScaler(train only) + RBF SVC; train on clean train plus two unanchored augmentation views (Gaussian noise .15*16 and pixel dropout .15); C/gamma selected by validation accuracy
candidate: Same model and fixed augmentation views; each augmentation pulled toward clean standardized train class centroid with alpha=severity/max_severity; hyperparameter score=(3-fold stratified clean-train CV accuracy + held-out validation accuracy)/2; at inference, only samples below validation-derived 20th percentile max decision margin are reconstructed from top 32 PCA components fit on clean train images; then classify.

fixed_pca.trigger: validation 20th percentile of maximum SVC decision value; fixed per seed

pass_fail_rule: Primary full arm is supported_pilot only if its mean primary metric exceeds control across three seeds and the mean paired gain is positive; otherwise no_gain. Also report each ablation without post-hoc promotion. No significance claim or novelty claim.
test_policy: No test score read before this preregistration. Final mode is run once per seed; no hyperparameter or threshold changes afterward.
known_deviations: Proposal says two augmentation severities but does not specify their values; use benchmark-matched clean + one noise-0.15 view + one dropout-0.15 view (3x training rows).
Proposal describes thresholded PCA denoising and a validation/CV composite proxy; no live validation gradient is implemented.
Task fixture defines nine conditions; this overrides proposal metric shorthand referring to two corruption conditions.
